note: Owner-supplied style samples (2026-10-08). Stored as plain git blobs (cloud session cannot upload LFS). The fourth sample was the existing ART-CH01-001 master, retained as the density counter-example. 2026-10-11: the owner re-supplied STYLE-REF-01/02/03 as the art-direction examples (byte-identical by perceptual hash) and added a Dying Lands map as inspiration. 2026-10-11 (later): the owner moved the benchmark to 'old school black and white gritty' art with ten more examples. Seven pure-black-ink examples became STYLE-REF-04..10; three ink-wash examples are inspiration only (grey tone cannot print); the eleventh was STYLE-REF-03 again (byte-identical). STYLE-REF-01/02 (clean engraved line) are superseded and no longer attached. 2026-10-11 (later still): the owner cut STYLE-REF-01 (file removed; it remains in git history) and asked for the best of four attached city scenes instead. STYLE-REF-11 is the bold black-and-white one; two of the others were near copies of the approved sepia Greythorn render and the fourth was denser, closer to the rejected hyper-detailed look. 2026-10-11: the owner promoted STYLE-REF-02 and STYLE-REF-08 back into the attached sets. 2026-10-11: the owner banked sixteen more examples (STYLE-REF-12..27) covering still lifes, beasts, wilderness, interiors and magic, with more to come. They are recorded under 'banked' and are not attached until the owner chooses. A second batch added STYLE-REF-28..40 to the bank (one more image was STYLE-REF-26 again, byte-identical, and was not stored twice). 2026-10-11: on owner instruction Claude searched for public-domain examples to fill the remaining gaps and added STYLE-REF-41..44 (Callot, Piranesi, Haden; Art Institute of Chicago CC0). Their scans were levelled and plate numbers or signatures removed. 2026-10-12: the owner promoted most of the bank (max four references per item); each entry's 'use' now states the sets it is attached to, generated from config/art_style.json. 2026-10-12 (later): STYLE-REF-22 removed from the beast set by the owner; eight more owner samples added as STYLE-REF-45..52. 2026-10-12 (later): fourteen more owner samples added as STYLE-REF-54..67 (a fifteenth was STYLE-REF-53 again, byte-identical, and was not stored twice).
